section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Rear Axle Hub
ocr_text:
5. TEMPORARILY CONNECT STRUT ROD

6. TORQUE UPPER ARM MOUNTING NUT
Torque: 1,100 kg·cm (80 ft·lb, 108 N·m)

7. CONNECT SHOCK ABSORBER
Torque: 1,400 kg·cm (101 ft·lb, 137 N·m)

8. INSTALL PARKING BRAKE ASSEMBLY
(See page BR-43)

9. INSTALL ROTOR DISC
(See page BR-45)

10. INSTALL REAR DRIVE SHAFT
(See page RA-21)

11. INSTALL BRAKE CALIPER
Torque: 475 kg·cm (34 ft·lb, 47 N·m)

12. TORQUE SUSPENSION PARTS
(a) Install the wheel and lower the vehicle.
(b) Bounce the vehicle up and down to stabilize the suspension.
